messages:
james_acme: hey team, we're seeing missing audit entries for a handful of users after our SCIM sync yesterday. deprovisions didn't show up in the audit export and we had to manually re-create access. Can someone triage?

sarah_support: sorry to hear that, james. can you confirm the approximate time window and org id? any error messages from the SCIM logs? :wave:

james_acme: window ~ 2026-03-10 03:20-03:40 UTC, org: acme-123. SCIM job reported 200s but the audit export (admin -> exports) doesn't contain deprov events. Also noticed a billing spike for token-unlock retries around same time.

ivan_infra: tagging infra to look at SCIM->provisioner pipeline. do you have a sample user id we can search for?

james_acme: user 'mike.b@acme.com' (uid: 99432). tried to repro in staging by deprov + repro sync; staging shows the deprov event in /audit but production export missing lines.

maria_security: this flags two things: (1) possible audit-export retention/rollup bug, (2) correlation with kms unwrap/retry could mean the export job failed mid-batch and retried without marking events as exported. leo, can you pull KMS unwrap logs for that timeframe?

leo_oncall: pulling logs now. quick note: our unwrap proxy reported intermittent HSM timeouts 03:25-03:33 UTC and returned transient errors to the provisioner. logs show repeated unwrap failures for tenant acme-123: 

```
2026-03-10T03:25:03Z kms-proxy ERROR unwrap failed: hsm_rpc_timeout (txn=0x7f3a)
2026-03-10T03:25:04Z kms-proxy INFO retrying unwrap (attempt=2)
2026-03-10T03:25:07Z provisioner WARN scim: deprov succeeded but token_unwrap_retry_count=3
```

leo_oncall: looks like SCIM deprov completed (we returned 200 upstream) but the provisioner logged unwrap/retry and the audit-export worker may have skipped the event if it didn't get the valid encryption key at the time.

sarah_support: james — can you confirm if any deprovisioned users lost access to paid features which would explain the billing spike?

james_acme: yes — two service accounts lost deprov state and our usage meter kept counting for ~20 minutes until we manually revoked API keys. that's the billing bump.

ivan_infra: next steps I propose: (A) immediate: manual audit fix for missing events + one-off billing adjustment, (B) short-term: backfill audit export for acme-123 for 03:20-03:40, (C) long-term: ensure export worker retries are idempotent and survive transient KMS failures.

maria_security: for compliance, we need provenance: which events were missing and whether any retention windows were impacted. assign to security investigation and preserve HSM logs and export-worker offsets. This might be treated as a P1 compliance ticket.

leo_oncall: I can produce a minimal repro: 1) enable SCIM deprov for a test user 2) inject HSM latency (simulate timeout) 3) run export worker. If the export worker skipped the event, we have a reproducible flow.

sarah_support: can you paste the repro steps and a short checklist into the support ticket? james, we'll also open a billing escalation to review the 20-minute overcharge — do you want a credit or invoice adjustment?

james_acme: prefer credit and a short RCA. thanks.

ivan_infra: assigning infra owner @ivan_infra, security @maria_security, oncall @leo_oncall, support @sarah_support. action items:
- leo: export HSM rpc traces for 03:20-03:40 UTC (preserve raw logs)
- ivan: run backfill job to re-export audit events for acme-123; add idempotency guard on export worker
- maria: document compliance impact and recommended retention changes (if any)
- sarah: open billing ticket for credit and notify customer SLA team

maria_security: also add a temporary mitigator: if export worker sees a KMS unwrap retry count > 0, mark event as "pending-encrypted" rather than dropping, so we can reconcile later.

leo_oncall: starting log pull now. ETA ~30m.
sarah_support: thanks everyone — james i'll DM you the support ticket link and the follow-up ETA. :thumbsup:

james_acme: appreciated. please include the repro and we can help run it in our staging.

deploy-bot: deploy started: export-worker@release-3.14 -> prod (canary 10%)

ivan_infra: noting deploy. if canary looks good we'll push idempotency fix to 100% and then run backfill after stopping exports for a 2m window to avoid duplicates.

sarah_support: thread summary for ticket: missing SCIM deprov audit lines for acme-123 due to transient HSM timeouts causing KMS unwrap retries; manual remediation and billing credit requested; infra to backfill and harden export-worker handling of KMS transient failures.

maria_security: tagging compliance: please escalate to legal if backfilled events change audit evidence ordering.

james_acme: okay thanks, will wait for creds/credit confirmation and the RCA.
